novel_features.name: Export balances (ProjectionLab-shaped)
novel_features.description: One-shot export of current account balances reshaped into ProjectionLab's expected schema, ready to sync into a net-worth projection tool.
novel_features.rationale: Requires mapping YNAB's account model (type, on/off-budget) into a downstream tool's schema — a real transformation, not a passthrough.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to feed another finance tool's import step; it's the direct replacement for a hand-maintained account-mapping script.

novel_features.name: Reconciliation helper
novel_features.description: Diff the local cleared-transaction total against a bank statement balance and surface the transaction(s) most likely responsible for the gap.
novel_features.rationale: Requires summing locally-mirrored cleared transactions and diffing against a user-supplied figure — no API endpoint does this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this monthly instead of eyeballing a statement line by line.

novel_features.name: Payee spend profile
novel_features.description: Aggregated monthly spend stats, average transaction size, and typical categories for a single payee.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local aggregation across a payee's full transaction history by month.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to understand a recurring payee's spend pattern rather than scanning raw transaction lists.

narrative.headline: Every YNAB feature, plus a local mirror that makes reconciliation, payee trend analysis, and a ready-made ProjectionLab export instant instead of manual.
narrative.value_prop: This CLI mirrors your budget locally so bank reconciliation and payee spend history become instant, offline, agent-native commands instead of manual math against a live API and a 200-request-per-hour ceiling. It also ships a one-shot export shaped for downstream net-worth tools like ProjectionLab.
narrative.auth_narrative: Uses a YNAB Personal Access Token (Account Settings -> Developer Settings -> New Token in the YNAB web app). Set YNAB_API_TOKEN, or run auth login to store it in the OS keychain.

quickstart.comment: Verify the binary and config resolve before touching the network.
Find your plan (budget) ID — everything else is scoped to it.
See current-month category balances at a glance.
Get current balances shaped for a downstream net-worth tool.

troubleshoots.fix: Re-check YNAB_API_TOKEN or run 'ynab-pp-cli auth login' — tokens don't expire but can be revoked from YNAB's Developer Settings.
YNAB caps tokens at 200 requests/hour. Narrow --since-date on transaction/list calls and avoid re-fetching the same data in a tight loop.

troubleshoots.symptom: Amounts look 1000x too large or too small
troubleshoots.fix: The raw API uses milliunits; this CLI converts to/from whole currency units at the boundary automatically — don't do the math yourself.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI for anything touching a YNAB budget: reading balances/categories/transactions, entering or approving transactions, funding categories, and — distinctly — trend/forecast/reconciliation questions that need history the live API doesn't retain.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to manage non-YNAB institutions (bank, brokerage, credit union) directly — it only talks to YNAB.
Do not use this CLI to create YNAB categories, category groups, or payees — the YNAB API itself doesn't support that; use the YNAB app.
Do not use 'export balances' as a general-purpose account API; it's shaped specifically for downstream net-worth tooling.
